selection: After Timey-Wimey, by release order and pinned-index order within each edition: three remaining Doctor Who decks, four Lost Caverns of Ixalan decks, Raining Cats and Dogs, Revenant Recon and Deadly Disguise. Deep Clue Sea is already present; Blame Game falls after this batch and retains its previous exclusion. Preserve every original card regardless of legality. No substitutions or alternate-edition duplicates.
moxfieldAccess: The pinned index supplies queue links. These are verified Wizards / MTGJSON lists, not direct Moxfield exports.
normalization: Flip, Adventure and double-faced cards use their front names for source comparison and resolve to existing canonical aliases during intake; split cards retain their combined names. The source labels Ransom Note (Surveil) and Ransom Note (Morph) resolve to the same Ransom Note identity. Quantity spacing in the official HTML is normalized. Time Lord is a single creature type. Full Scryfall faces are preserved in oracle.json.
